privacy.a: Yes. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, access is role-based, and we never train public models on your data.

0.title: 1. Introduction
0.content: Anselio (“we,” “us,” or “our”) provides an AI-first Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform that enables businesses to deploy AI-powered agents across voice, chat, email, SMS, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger channels. This Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect information about you when you access or use our website, platform, and related services.

content.intro: We collect information you provide directly to us, information automatically collected when you use our services, and information from third parties. The categories of information we collect include:
list: Account Information: When you register for an account, we collect your name, email address, profile picture, and organization details through our authentication provider, Clerk.
Organization Information: Organization name, billing details, plan type, and configuration settings for your AI agents.

Customer Communications: All messages, call recordings, transcripts, and metadata exchanged between your end customers and AI agents across all channels (voice, chat, email, SMS, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger).
Call Data: Twilio call SIDs, call duration, recording URLs, transcripts, voice input and output audio processed through our AI pipeline via OpenRouter and Vapi.
Lead Data: Customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, company names, and notes captured through AI agent conversations.
Knowledge Base Content: Documents, text, and files you upload to train and configure your AI agents.
Integration Credentials: OAuth tokens and connection credentials for third-party services you connect (Gmail, Meta/Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp).
Usage Data: Analytics on session counts, resolution rates, handle times, and feature usage for service improvement.
Error Data: Error reports and stack traces collected via Sentry when crashes occur.
Communication Data: Inquiries you send to our support team via email or chat.
content.outro: We do not collect payment card information. All payment processing is handled by our payment processor, LemonSqueezy.

content.intro: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
list: To provide, operate, and maintain the Anselio platform and its features.
To process and respond to customer inquiries through AI agents across all integrated channels.
To transcribe and analyze voice calls and messages using AI-powered speech recognition and natural language processing via OpenRouter.
To generate summaries, sentiment scores, and quality assurance scores for each session.
To process billing and subscription management via LemonSqueezy.
To send transactional emails (agent invitations, lead alerts, appointment reminders, billing notifications) via Resend.
To improve our platform, develop new features, and conduct data analysis and research.
To detect, prevent, and address technical issues, fraud, and abuse.
To comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service.

3.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR & Law 09-08)
3.content: We process your personal data on the following legal bases: (a) Contractual Necessity — processing is necessary to perform our contract with you and provide the services you requested; (b) Legitimate Interests — processing for service improvement, security, and analytics serves our legitimate business interests; (c) Consent — where you have explicitly consented, such as connecting third-party integrations via OAuth; (d) Legal Obligation — processing required to comply with applicable laws, including Morocco’s Law 09-08 on protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data.

content.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We share your information only with trusted third-party service providers who help us operate our platform, subject to contractual obligations that ensure your data is protected. These providers include:
list: Clerk — Authentication and multi-tenant organization management. Clerk receives your name, email, and authentication credentials.
Supabase — Database hosting (Postgres) and real-time data synchronization. All application data is stored on Supabase infrastructure.

OpenRouter — AI language model processing, speech-to-text (Whisper), and text-to-speech. Full message content, call transcripts, and audio are sent to OpenRouter for processing. OpenRouter operates as a proxy to AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others.
Twilio — Telephony infrastructure for voice calls, SMS, and WhatsApp messaging. Call audio, phone numbers, and message content are processed through Twilio.
Vapi — Voice AI pipeline for processing voice conversations. Call audio, transcripts, and conversation metadata are shared with Vapi.
Resend — Transactional and inbound email delivery. Email content and addresses are processed by Resend.
LemonSqueezy — Payment processing and subscription management. Your organization ID, user ID, email, and name are shared; no payment card data passes through our systems.
Google (Gmail API) — Email integration. If you connect your Gmail account, your email content and metadata are accessed via the Gmail API.
Meta (Facebook/Instagram) — Messenger and Instagram DM integration. Message content and sender information are processed when you connect these channels.
Sentry — Error tracking and performance monitoring. Error stack traces and performance data are collected when enabled.
content.outro: We may also disclose your information if required by law, court order, or governmental regulation, or to protect our rights, property, or safety.

5.title: 6. International Data Transfers
5.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own, including the United States, the European Union, and Morocco, where our service providers operate. When we transfer data across borders, we implement appropriate safeguards, including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) where required, to ensure your data receives an adequate level of protection in accordance with applicable data protection laws including Morocco’s Law 09-08 and the GDPR.

6.title: 7. Data Retention
6.content: We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you with the services. When you delete your account or request data deletion, we will delete or anonymize your personal data within a reasonable period, subject to legal retention requirements. Session data, call recordings, transcripts, and messages are retained for the duration of your subscription and may be retained in anonymized form for analytics purposes.

content.intro: Under Morocco’s Law 09-08 and the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
list: Right of Access: You may request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Right to Rectification: You may request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Right to Erasure (“Right to be Forgotten”): You may request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal obligations.
Right to Restriction of Processing: You may request that we limit how we process your data.
Right to Data Portability: You may request a copy of your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Right to Object: You may object to processing based on legitimate interests, including for direct marketing.
Right to Withdraw Consent: Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.
content.outro: To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@anselio.com. We will respond to your request within 30 days as required by applicable law.

8.title: 9. Security
8.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data, including: encryption of data in transit (TLS) and at rest (via Supabase); row-level security policies scoping all data to your organization; encrypted storage of OAuth tokens and credentials; webhook signature verification on all incoming third-party webhooks; and rate limiting on public endpoints. Despite these measures, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

9.title: 10. Changes to This Notice
9.content: We may update this Privacy Notice from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you by email (sent to the address on your account) or through a notice on our platform. Your continued use of the services after the effective date of the changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated notice.

10.title: 11. Contact
10.content: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Notice or our data practices, please contact us at privacy@anselio.com or by mail at Anselio, 202 Boulevard Mohammed V, Casablanca 20000, Morocco.

0.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
0.content: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, enhance user experience, and provide information to the owners of the site. This Cookie Notice explains how Anselio uses cookies and similar technologies on our website and platform.

content.intro: We use only a limited set of cookies and local storage items to operate our platform:
list: sidebar:state (localStorage): Stores your sidebar menu preference (open/closed) to maintain a consistent user experience across sessions.
Clerk Session Cookies: Our authentication provider, Clerk, sets essential session cookies and CSRF tokens to authenticate users and maintain secure sessions.
Session Cookies: Standard server-side session cookies required for platform functionality.
content.outro: We do not use any cookies for advertising, tracking, or analytics purposes.

content.intro: Some third-party services we integrate with may set their own cookies:
list: Clerk: Sets authentication and session cookies necessary for user login and organization management.
LemonSqueezy: Sets cookies on their hosted checkout pages for payment processing and fraud prevention.
Sentry: Sets a session cookie for error tracking, only if error monitoring is enabled.
content.outro: We do not control these third-party cookies. Review the privacy policies of these providers for more information.

3.title: 4. Your Choices
3.content: Since we use only strictly necessary cookies and functional local storage for platform operation, these cannot be disabled without affecting platform functionality. You can manage or delete cookies and local storage through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to control cookie acceptance, rejection, and deletion.

faqPage.title: Anselio: AI customer service in Morocco, answered.
faqPage.intro: Everything buyers and support teams ask about Anselio — the product, the channels, Darija, Moroccan phone numbers, pricing and data handling — in short, self-contained answers.

setup.q: How long does it take to launch an AI agent?
setup.a: Most teams are live the same day. You connect your content — documents, FAQ pages, your help centre or past conversations — choose the channels, then publish. Configuration happens in the dashboard with no code, and a test conversation runs before anything goes live.

darija.q: Does Anselio actually speak Moroccan Darija?
darija.a: Yes. The agent replies in Moroccan Arabic (Darija), Modern Standard Arabic, French or English, and follows whichever language the customer uses. Darija is handled by speech recognition and language models that support the dialect; when confidence is low, the conversation is offered to a human instead of being guessed.

voiceNumber.q: Do I need a new phone number for AI voice calls?
voiceNumber.a: Anselio provides Moroccan numbers, so customers call a local +212 number instead of paying international rates. Pro includes one number, one concurrent line and 300 AI voice minutes per month; extra number packs, concurrent lines and Enterprise volume are ordered through sales. Numbers are delivered over cloud SIP, with about one week of lead time.

pricing.a: The Free plan costs {free}: one agent, 50 conversations a month, website chat only. Starter is {starter} per month for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and email. Pro is {pro} per month and adds SMS, API access and one Moroccan number with 300 AI voice minutes. Prices are in Moroccan Dirham, excluding 20% VAT; annual billing takes 15% off; Enterprise is a custom contract.

freePlan.q: Is there a free plan, and do I need a credit card?
freePlan.a: Yes, and no. The Free plan needs no credit card and includes one AI agent, 50 conversations a month, the website chat widget and 10 MB of knowledge base. It is meant for running the product on a real site; upgrade only when you need more channels or volume.

humanHandoff.q: What happens when the AI cannot answer?
humanHandoff.a: The conversation is handed to a human with the full transcript, the customer's details and the agent's summary, in the live inbox. A customer can ask for a person at any point on any channel, and that request is always honoured. The agent does not keep a conversation it cannot resolve.

about.title: Anselio is an AI customer service platform built in Casablanca.
about.intro: Anselio gives Moroccan businesses AI agents that answer customers in Darija, Arabic, French and English across website chat, email, WhatsApp, social messaging, SMS and inbound phone calls — and hand over to a person when a conversation needs one.
about.introDetail: The product exists because the alternative was a choice between a rigid phone menu and a chatbot built for English. Anselio answers from the business's own content, acts in its tools, and keeps one conversation history across channels, so a customer who writes on WhatsApp and calls an hour later is recognised.

items.0: Answers from your documents, FAQ pages and past conversations using retrieval-augmented generation, so replies come from your material rather than general knowledge.
items.1: Takes actions: books appointments, captures leads, fills custom forms, and looks up orders and accounts through tools.
items.2: Hands a conversation to a teammate with the transcript, customer details and a summary, in the live inbox.
items.3: Enforces guardrails: what the agent may promise, what it must escalate, and which data it must never ask for.
items.4: Scores and analyses every conversation automatically, so quality is reviewed on all traffic rather than on a sample.

items.0: Moroccan and North African small and mid-sized businesses
items.2: Clinics, salons, schools and other appointment-based businesses

0.title: Connect your content
0.body: Upload documents, point the agent at your help centre or FAQ pages, or import past conversations. Knowledge is indexed per organisation and stays scoped to it.

1.title: Set the rules
1.body: Choose tone, languages and channels, define the guardrails and the tools the agent may use, and test real scenarios before publishing.

2.title: Publish and supervise
2.body: Deploy to the website widget, WhatsApp, email or a Moroccan phone line. Supervisors follow live conversations and take over when needed.

compliance.title: Data and compliance
compliance.body: Customer conversations are personal data. Anselio is operated from Morocco under law 09-08, with GDPR-aligned handling, encryption in transit and at rest, and role-based access in the dashboard. Customer content is never used to train public models.

items.0: Data protection law 09-08 practices, with a GDPR-aligned data processing agreement
items.1: Encryption in transit and at rest; conversation content is never stored in public buckets
items.2: Role-based access, with distinct roles for agents, supervisors and administrators
items.3: A customer can ask for a human at any time, and the request is always honoured
